set.body:
Objective
Give every RAS-mm coordinate system a distinct persistent frame identity and replace the shared 'scalafim-ras-d3' id.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (D1 identity rules). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
image; scalafim.image.space, SampleSpaces.persistentFrameId. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. WorldSpace {Template, SubjectNative(ns, subject, session, ReferenceAcquisition), SubjectTkRas, Declared(token,label)}; DatasetNamespace scoping; GeometryDigest over dims, selected vox2world and codes.
2. FrameCatalog is the only creator of world frames (Frame.createPersistent, RAS, mm); declare(label) is fresh each call.
3. SampleSpaces derives persistent ids from WorldSpace; the constant id is gone.
4. Restoration re-binds by persistent FrameKey via image4s Frame.alignOwners/FrameAlignment, never by label.
5. Tests: sub-01 in two datasets distinct; two boldrefs in one session distinct; independently loaded representations of one frame bind; declare is fresh; persisted key round-trips.

Verification
Bounded sbt batches: <module>JVM/test then <module>JS/test for touched modules; scalafimCompileAll warning-clean.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P1.02: WorldSpace identity: namespaces, reference acquisitions, fresh declarations, persistent restoration
